hypothesis: 全局集成后剩余错序可能集中在高环保、有补贴、低焦虑区域，并保留原子模型间的局部互补性。
primary_slice: Environmental_Concern_Level in {4,5} AND Subsidy_Available=Yes AND Range_Anxiety_Level=Low

protocol.row_order: train.csv canonical order; source SHA256 plus CTBoost IDs/targets/folds checked
protocol.consistency: five StratifiedKFold seed42 buckets; existing OOF only, different model training folds remain different
protocol.exact_metric: AUC pair error mass, ties half; decompose within group, positive-inside-negative-outside, positive-outside-negative-inside
protocol.complementarity: deterministic sampled positive-negative pairs quantify v100 errors repaired and v100 correct pairs broken by each existing model

decision_rule.local_expert_signal: An atomic model beats v100 within the preregistered primary slice by AUC>=0.0001 overall and in at least 4 of 5 seed42 buckets.
decision_rule.representation_priority: If the primary within-slice pairs explain >=25% of v100 global pair errors, prioritize a new representation hypothesis; this does not authorize promotion and must be freshly nested validated.
decision_rule.otherwise: NO_GO for a local expert based on existing predictions; report any sampled complementarity as diagnostic only.
